The ISxx00 Series Industrial Ethernet Switch has multiple
power inputs and all power inputs must be disconnected when the
device is powered off
Caution
目 Step 1 Place the back panel of the switch squarely on the DIN
rail, making sure the DIN rail fits into the space between the bow
latches near the top of the switch and the snaps near the bottom.
= Step 2 Move the lower portion of the switch away from the rail
and place the spring-loaded latch on the back of the switch on top
of the DIN rail
時 Step 3 Slowly move from the lower portion of the switch towards
the underside of the DIN rail and apply pressure so that the snap
on the back of the switch at the bottom snaps under the snap
gauge and snaps into place.
Instructions

may cause radio interference in life. In this case, the user may
required to take practical measures to avoid its interferen
The ISxx00 Series Industrial Ethernet Switch has multiple
power inputs and all power inputs must be disconnected when the
Hl device is powered oft.
